_about: Chess piece sets (docs/CHESS-LOOK-PLAN.md stage 4): 6 sets, white (w) and black (b), pawn P, knight N, bishop B, rook R, queen Q, king K. Cut out of white. Paint: python scripts/game_art.py docs/chess-art/sets.json paint ~/dragon-art-inbox/chess-sets

styles.a: Hand-painted fantasy storybook game piece, rich glowing colours, soft painterly light, bold clean readable silhouette, friendly for children aged 8 to 11, no writing, no letters, no numbers.
